items.title: Four Basic Types of GWs (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Four Basic Types of GWs: a main subheading of 8.6 Gravitational waves (GWs), its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 183-183.

blocks.text: Gravitational waves ki chaar basic types hain, har ek ke sources aur characteristics (khoobiyan) alag hain:

Jab koi akela bhaari object (jism), jaise neutron star, ek hi speed (raftar) se ghoome (spin kare) to ek hi frequency aur amplitude wali continuous GWs banti hain. White dwarf binary systems bhi continuous GWs banate hain.

Jab binary system, jaise do neutron stars, do black holes, ya ek neutron star aur ek black hole, ek doosre ke gird ghoomte hue andar ki taraf ghoom kar (spiral) qareeb aate hain, to compact binary inspiral GWs banti hain.
Yeh violent (shadeed) events, jaise supernova (sitare ka phatna), gamma-ray bursts ya cosmic strings, se paida hoti hain.

blocks.alt: Ek binary system: do black holes, baen taraf bara aur us ke daen chhota, halke neele khanon (grid) wali spacetime ki chadar ke ghoomte gaddhe (funnel) mein; bahar ki taraf mur kar phailti lehrein.
blocks.caption: BS Model: binary system (BS) ka model (kitab ki chhapi tasveer ke mutabiq original drawing).

blocks.text: Stochastic GWs kamzor aur random (be-tarteeb) signals hain jo bohat se kamzor sources, jaise door ke binary systems, ki waves ke aapas mein milne (superposition) se bante hain. Inhein pakarna sab se mushkil hai.

Har accelerate karne wala object gravitational waves paida karta hai, gariyan aur hawai jahaz bhi. Lekin Zameen par cheezon ka mass aur acceleration itne kam hain ke un ki waves hamare instruments se pakri ja sakne jitni bari nahi hotin.

Jab binary systems (binaries) ek doosre ke gird ghoomte hain to gravitational waves emit karte hain, jinhein LIGO (Laser Interferometer Gravitational wave Observatory, USA) aur Virgo (Cascina, Italy ki bari observatory) jaisi observatories pakar sakti hain. Yeh waves system ke mass, spin aur merger (milap) ki information laati hain aur light ki speed se chalti hain.

blocks.alt: Gehre neele sitaron bhare aasman par tirchhe nazar aate halke neele-safed ek-markazi (concentric) chhallon ke kai set, har ek ke beech mein chhota binary jora; baen neeche Zameen.
blocks.caption: Ek hi centre wale spheres (gole) ka silsila, jis ke centre mein binary system hai; yeh gravity waves ko bahar cosmos (kaainat) mein phaila raha hai (kitab ki chhapi tasveer ke mutabiq original drawing).

blocks.text: Binary systems gravitational waves ke bare sources hain, aur un ka merger (do bhaari objects ka takra kar ek zyada bhaari object ban jana) universe ke sab se intense events mein se hai.

Jab masses ghoomte aur accelerate karte hain to un ki gravitational intensity (shiddat) badalti hai, aur har direction (simt) mein bahar phailne wali waves banti hain. Yeh waves binary system ki gravity mein bound (qaid) nahi rehtin; light ki speed se spacetime mein freely (azadi se) chalti hain aur source se door jate hue kamzor hoti jati hain.

blocks.alt: Gehre neele sitaron bhare aasman mein do black holes, har ek ke gird ghoomte maadde ke roshan neele spiral baazu, ek baen oopar aur ek beech mein; manzar ke aar paar laal mitti ki patti.
blocks.caption: Tidal forces gravitational waves ka mathematical signature (pehchan ka nishaan) rakhti hain (kitab ki chhapi tasveer ke mutabiq original drawing).

blocks.alt: Two dark bodies orbiting each other at the centre of many concentric blue circles, with arrows pointing outward: gravitational waves spreading out from a binary system.
blocks.caption: Binary system se phailti gravitational waves (hamara apna khaaka; kitab ki tasveer nahi).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Yeh saada khaaka dikhata hai ke do bhaari objects ek doosre ke gird ghoomte hain aur un se waves light ki speed se har direction mein bahar jati hain, door ja kar kamzor hoti hain.
